label: Salesforce
assumptions: PTO treatment inside the quarterly quota is not documented — Badgy assumes approved leave reduces the working-day pool while the 10-day target stays absolute.

This preset models the Office-Flex engineering track; Office-Based roles such as sales, workplace services, data-centre engineering and onsite support are 4–5 days per week, while the Remote track has no office minimum.
The US federal holiday set is assumed for this preset.
notes: The separate Office-Based track is 4–5 days a week.
